newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine central bank sells dlrs at 29 pesos.
newsitem.headline: Philippine central bank sells dlrs at 29 pesos.

text.p: The Philippine central bank fired the first salvo at the currency market on Thursday, selling dollars at 29 pesos, traders said.
After thirty minutes of trading, volume was very light at $1 million.
"It (the central bank) just wants to make its presence felt in the market," a dealer said.

Traders said the peso will remain defensive through the day because of higher dollar demand from importers despite a new central bank ruling cutting further banks' long dollar positions to five percent of capital from 10 percent.
